text:
Tomas V.: hey team, day 3 here. trying to finish observability checklist: i can log into Datadog but unsure which key to use locally vs for our dev k8s. also i only see the top-level Grafana folder; the service dashboards aren't listed. Sentry shows no access. who do i poke to get minimal edit access so i can tweak a panel?

eng-infra-bot: Welcome Tomas! Please request observability access via https://go.redwood/obs-access-form and follow the onboarding checklist at https://go.redwood/onboard-checklist.

Jules (DevEx): welcome Tomas! short: Datadog keys live in 1Password at redwood/integrations/datadog/dev. Local: export DD_API_KEY and DD_ENV=dev. k8s: create a secret and reference it in helm. Grafana: folders are mapped to SSO groups; i'll add you to the "search-eng" group and share the folder. Sentry: invite should be pending to your work email; i'll re-send.

Maya (Observability): FYI i shared a read-only set called "New Hire: Observability" and gave you view rights on team/search dashboards. If you want edit rights on a specific panel file the dashboard id and i'll promote you. Also, set DD_TAGS="env:dev,team:search" so panels filter as expected.

Tomas V.: thanks. small follow-up: if i want to test a dashboard change locally, any recommendation to avoid altering prod dashboards?

Alex (SRE): clone the dashboard in Grafana (three-dot menu -> Duplicate) and prefix with "sandbox/". For local metric experiments, run the agent in no-upload mode or target the dev cluster:
```bash
# local-only agent for UI/debugging
docker run --rm -e DD_API_KEY=$DD_API_KEY -e DD_ENV=dev datadog/agent:latest agent run --no-cloud-upload
```
This avoids org ingestion.

Jules (DevEx): added you to SSO group and re-sent Sentry invite to tomas@redwood.com. if Sentry still says no access, logout and log back in to force SSO group sync.

Tomas V.: can see Grafana folder now and Sentry invite arrived. duplicated the dashboard and will test there. appreciate the quick help :raised_hands: Closing thread.
